claim: The exact RUN3 Fat.c GetFatParams() and PutBoot() source, driven only by the observed 4-byte FAT RandgetBytes output and the RUN3 format parameters, regenerates the complete 512-byte FAT16 boot sector bit-for-bit. Independent AES-XTS encryption at data unit 256 reproduces both the logged WRITE_DATA sector and the final container bytes at offset 0x20000.
